nodes.label: Source-Agnostic Core Engine
nodes.rationale: Marketplace integrations remain pluggable by implementing a common Source protocol rather than changing the core engine.

nodes.label: Official API Only Policy
nodes.rationale: HTML scraping may violate marketplace Terms of Service and create legal risk, so live access requires official credentials and compliance with rate-limit, attribution, and data-use requirements.

nodes.label: config-init
nodes.rationale: Creates a deterministic starter configuration with no marketplace access, database creation, or network request.

nodes.label: Legacy CLI Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Existing invocations without a subcommand remain supported while config-init is added.

nodes.label: Existing Canonical Owners
nodes.rationale: New donor behaviour should fit Config, RulesEngine, SQLiteStore, run_loop, and CLI rather than create a parallel subsystem.

nodes.label: Donor Evidence Requirement
nodes.rationale: Donor evidence must determine which remaining capability fits the existing canonical owners without creating a parallel subsystem.

nodes.label: list-seen Command
nodes.rationale: Expose persisted seen listing identities without fetching a marketplace source.

nodes.label: Canonical list-seen Placement
nodes.rationale: Stored-listing enumeration belongs in the existing SQLiteStore and CLI owners because canonical persistence uses URL identity; a new subsystem or schema would duplicate ownership.
